title: T10 — Candidate solutions (rework, 2026-11-22)
body:
# Candidate Solutions — T10 SAFe cadence and MSP tranches

## Candidates

| Candidate | Shape | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Cadence state machine with an approved PI plan | explicit `planned → approved → running → closed` states; materialisation gated on the approved plan | adopted |
| Cron-only backlog drain | a schedule that moves cards by stored priority | rejected: no approval gate, no idempotent tick |
| Stored WSJF score | persist the computed score on the WBS row | rejected: the score is a function of four integers and is recomputed (§8.2) |
| Free-text demo evidence | any non-empty note satisfies the demo credit | rejected: replaced by typed evidence (`demo_gate.rs`) |
| Tranche review by prose | the review records its own claim | rejected: the review must cite baselines, benefit status and the risk register (`tranche_review.rs`) |

## Criteria

The five §12 clauses: plan approval before materialisation; WIP-bounded WSJF order; typed demo
evidence; a retro lesson requirement; a tranche review and benefit transition that cannot pass
without measured evidence. Secondary: an idempotent tick, refinement of unscored/aged rows, and
a record that reads back through the product's own actions.

## Options rejected

The stored-score and free-text shapes are the ones the V1 audit found still live
(`v1-p83-1`, `v1-p83-4`); they are named as gaps, not as accepted design. The cron-only drain
never existed in code and was rejected at design time because it cannot carry an approval gate.
